projects.title: PolyNite
projects.tagline: Drop a model. Step inside it.
projects.description: A WebGPU-powered GLB and glTF viewer. Drop a 3D model and explore it instantly with dynamic lighting, materials, animations and Nanite-like adaptive geometry - then step inside it in VR.
projects.short: A WebGPU GLB viewer with adaptive geometry, scene lighting and VR.

features.title: Drag & drop GLB
features.text: Drop a .glb or .gltf anywhere on the page. Nothing is uploaded.

features.title: VR mode
features.text: Put on a headset and walk around your model at real scale.

features.title: Adaptive geometry
features.text: Nanite-like cluster LOD keeps dense meshes fast without losing detail.

features.title: Build a scene
features.text: Lighting, environments and materials to frame a model properly.

features.title: Share it
features.text: Send what you built and it opens in any browser.

features.title: Any device
features.text: One viewer, from a phone to a headset.

slides.title: PolyNite
slides.text: Drop a GLB and explore every detail - in your browser, or in VR.

slides.title: Drag. Drop. Done.
slides.text: Drop a .glb or .gltf on the page and it opens instantly, with lighting, materials and animation. Nothing to install, nothing uploaded.

slides.title: It sees clusters
slides.text: PolyNite breaks every mesh into thousands of small clusters. Each frame, the engine keeps only the clusters — and the level of detail — the camera actually needs.

slides.title: You see the model
slides.text: None of that work is visible. What reaches the screen is the full model — lit, shaded and animated in real time.

slides.title: See it at real scale
slides.text: Open the same scene on a headset and walk around your model in VR - no export, no second tool.

slides.title: More than a preview
slides.text: Load, inspect, optimise, light, share - and step inside.

projects.title: RayLab
projects.description: A realtime blob raytracer running on WebGPU. Soft shadows, a BVH-accelerated scene, adaptive resolution and a side-by-side VR view.
projects.short: A realtime blob raytracer on WebGPU, viewable in VR.

features.title: Realtime raytracing
features.text: Every pixel traced on the GPU. No rasteriser anywhere in the pipeline.

features.title: VR mode
features.text: Side-by-side stereo, traced live for each eye.

features.title: Soft shadows
features.text: Penumbra and contact shadows straight out of the tracer.

features.title: BVH accelerated
features.text: A bounding-volume hierarchy keeps the scene fast as it grows.

features.title: Adaptive resolution
features.text: The render scale follows the framerate instead of dropping it.

features.title: Blob geometry
features.text: Capsules and spheres blended into creatures - maths, not meshes.

slides.title: RayLab
slides.text: Every pixel traced in real time. No meshes, no rasteriser - rays, blobs and light, on WebGPU.

slides.title: Traced for each eye
slides.text: The same scene in side-by-side stereo - shadows and light computed live, from inside.
